troubleshooting.symptom: MCP client fails while starting or parsing the first message.
troubleshooting.check: Use npm --silent run mcp. Plain npm run mcp may print npm lifecycle banners to stdout, which corrupts MCP stdio JSON-RPC.
Pass an absolute local path or set the client cwd so a relative projectPath resolves to an existing directory.
Use a Cargo project or workspace directory containing at least one Cargo.toml.
Ensure projectPath is inside a Git work tree and that there are unstaged working-tree changes, staged changes with staged=true, or explicit base/head changes.

troubleshooting.symptom: The server starts from a client but tools are not visible.
troubleshooting.check: Run npm run typecheck and npm test locally, then restart the MCP client so it reloads the tool list.
